text:
This treatment follows the 2021 chapter and its references
\parencite[pp.~265--275]{Merin2021Relevance}. Merin's argument for the
status of the axioms, the provenance of the measures, notes~1, 5, 8, 11--14,
17--20, the routes to the old-evidence problem, Pearl's diagnostic thesis,
measure pluralism, the comparison with Carnap's relevance theory, the
characterization of the measure Z, and the standing of every cited work are given in
Chapter~\ref{sec:p15-w02b-p15-024-relevance}.
reason: ED26-BM-RAT2021-4-3-C02/C05: lines 9-10 claim the complete chapter including all twenty notes, but notes 1, 5, 8, 11-14, 17-20, the p. 271 axiom-status argument, the p. 268 old-evidence routes, the p. 267 Pearl/Reichenbach claims and the p. 274 pluralism reference are treated in the new chapter sec:p15-w02b-p15-024-relevance (sections sec:p15-w02b-p15-024-cited-routes and sec:p15-w02b-p15-024-dependents), not here. The replacement removes the overclaim and points to that chapter. Requires the new chapter to be inserted per the packet insertion proposal.
